calling_convention.source: revealed by source comment L348 and tracing jda+dap+xct through SIMH
calling_convention.jda_Y: M[Y] ← AC (hi-dividend / dividend); AC ← return-PC; PC ← Y+1
calling_convention.idv_entry: dividend in AC; jda idv; lac divisor (at return address, xct'd by dv1)
calling_convention.dvd_entry: lac hi-dividend; lio lo-dividend; jda dvd; lac divisor
calling_convention.returns: quotient in AC, remainder in IO
calling_convention.dv1_mechanism: dap dv1 patches the xct slot with return-PC; dv1 executes lac divisor to load divisor into AC; idx dv1 twice (normal) or once (overflow/dve) advances return target
calling_convention.overflow_path: dve fires when hi-div - |divisor| ≥ 0 (quotient would not fit 18 bits); also fires for ÷0; returns 0 in AC for ÷0 (game gravity ÷0 produces 0, per EPIC §Final Note)
